market_summary: At 13:30 UTC during the London/NY Overlap, simultaneous macroeconomic releases sparked sharp intrabar surges across all monitored assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD). Across all charts, the forming 15-minute bars pushed straight into major overhead resistance barriers—specifically Value Area Highs, session VWAPs, and EMA50 baselines—while Cumulative Delta remained either neutral or distinctly bearish, exhibiting noticeable divergence. Because none of the signal candles confirmed these breakouts with RVOL > 2.0 yellow spikes and entry would involve chasing volatile intrabar wicks into key supply zones, capital preservation dictates an unequivocal HOLD across all symbols.
